newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Best Buy EPS estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Best Buy EPS estimates cut.

text.p: --Piper Jaffray analyst Saul Yaari said Wednesday he cut his earnings estimates for Best Buy Co Inc after the company reported a loss for its fiscal third quarter ended November 30.

--Yaari said he cut his fourth quarter earnings estimate to $0.10 a share from $0.30. For the full fiscal 1997, ending Febrary 1997, Yaari said he cut his earnings estimate to $0.16 a share from $0.42.
--Piper Jaffray also cut its fiscal 1998 earnings estimate to $0.50 a share from $0.75, Yaari said.
--Piper Jaffray is maintaining its market performer rating on the consumer electronics and personal computer retailer.
--Earlier, Best Buy reported a third quarter operating loss of $0.04 a share. Yaari said he had expected an operating profit of $0.02 per share.
